assertions: A user completion confirmation returns Project completed even when checkpoint materialization raises disk full.
The failed checkpoint Operation is queryable with status failed and a stable error code.
A rebuild still reports Project completed; the user decision is not rolled back.
After rebuild, durability.reconcile rematerializes the failed operation and returns a verified checkpoint digest.
A real daemon smoke uses a one-shot marker, queries the failed operation over HTTP, and retries through the public checkpoint CLI to produce a sealed pointer.
scope: public command dispatcher with deterministic fixture failure and real daemon process smoke
limits: The one-shot marker is test-only and consumed before staging; normal runtime has no failure injection.
The user CLI retry creates a fresh checkpoint operation; the main Agent reconcile path updates the failed operation in place.
